description: Highway Curves and Grades in Colorado 2016 is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Highway curvature and gradient data in sections across Colorado since 1998. Contains detailed data on selected roadways, including rigidity, flexibility, curvature, grade, sight distance, speed limits, length of green time, etc from the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT). Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are curves, bic, cdot, colorado, colorado department of transportation. The table has 42 columns. Attribution on the portal: CDOT. The portal shows 2016-03-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
